regions.explanation: At 8.47s, between “the” and “dignity”, a 1.45 s silence replaced the reference's 120 ms pause. A long silence where the reference has none - especially mid-phrase - breaks the syntactic unit and signals lost place rather than deliberate emphasis. Fix: Keep this phrase in one breath; pause at the punctuation instead.
